A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E are available and support reliable comparison, including matching the renumbered appendix figure.

before.justification: v1 reports original CNN training experiments, neural and behavioral alignment measurements, representation-similarity analyses, and controlled latent-variability experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds ResNet-50 alignment results on non-public Brain-Score benchmarks in Figure C.6.

M1.justification: The ResNet architectures, spatial and category prediction objectives, loss combinations, and training procedures remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: The TDW datasets, ImageNet, prediction tasks, and public/non-public neural benchmarks are retained. New Figure C.6 evaluates another architecture on the same non-public benchmark suite already used in Figure C.5.

E2.justification: The comparison groups are unchanged. New Figure C.6 retains the spatial-latent, TDW category/identity, combined-objective, ImageNet category, and untrained groups used in the existing non-public comparison.

E3.justification: v2 adds the ResNet-50 configuration to non-public benchmark evaluation. Appendix C also revises its previously general candidate-layer specification: the earlier lists now apply to public benchmarks, while non-public evaluations use conv1, layer1–layer4, and fc. This reported protocol revision does not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The latent-variability ablations, dataset-size sensitivity, representation-similarity analyses, and decoding studies are unchanged. Figure C.6 adds benchmark scores for another architecture without introducing a distinct ablation or robustness manipulation.

E5.justification: Seed counts, standard-deviation reporting, cross-validation, and Mann-Whitney tests are retained. Figure C.6 follows the existing per-model point display without adding a new uncertainty-estimation or statistical-testing practice.

E6.justification: New Figure C.6 adds ResNet-50 scores for individual non-public benchmarks, regional averages, and the overall neural average. Existing results, including Tables C.1–C.3 and the ResNet-18 non-public results in Figure C.5, remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The loss definitions in Appendix B, equations 1–13, and mathematical descriptions of representation analysis are unchanged. No new assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and discussion retain the same claims about spatial-task neural alignment, representational similarity, and the role of non-target latent variability.

C2.justification: The mechanism interpretations and limitations remain substantively unchanged, including synthetic-versus-natural image differences, heterogeneous IT benchmark findings, and reliance on regression-based alignment metrics. Section 5 updates figure references without changing these qualifications.

D1.justification: v1 promises future release of dataset-generation code in Appendix A.1; v2 removes that promise and supplies a code-and-datasets repository link on page 1. Appendices B.1 and C also clarify architecture assignments and public versus non-public layer selection. The PDFs establish the access pointer, not its external contents.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to earlier research are unchanged. The added ICLR publication header is a publication-status edit.

P1.justification: v2 adds the conference-publication header and makes limited prose and cross-reference edits, principally in Section 5 and Appendices A–C. The main narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the multipanel Figure C.6 for ResNet-50 non-public results. The former Figure C.6 becomes C.7; existing figures and table structures are retained, with limited caption, header, and layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: v2 provides useful additional ResNet-50 evidence on the retained non-public benchmarks and improves reproducibility reporting through explicit layer-selection details and a code/data access link. These are incremental benefits; the existing results and substantive limitations remain intact, and the linked resources cannot be verified from the PDFs.
